name: Header and Footer Scripts
description: Allows you to add the scripts and styles on overall site from the front-end. No need to open files and add them there.
project_description:
This module allows you to add style and scripts in your site or

, You don't need to open any file for this purpose.

 Quick usage 

Navigate to admin/config/development/header-and-footer-scripts/header 

Add style e.g:

 
 

 
 

 
 

#header { color: grey; } 

 
 
 Add script e.g:

 On mostly sites, this section is used to add the Google Tag Manager. You can also add multiple scripts here with multiple ways, For example:

 
 

 Write Your code here

 

 
 

 

 
 

 

 
 

console.log("HFS Body"); 

 
 
 Press 'save configuration'.

 You will be able to insert Google Analytics or other Web-analytics code, meta-informations, CSS and JS codes to . You will be able to insert html and/or JavaScript codes to footer of your site. Good place for Clicky Web Analytics, Twitter, Facebook or any other social media script.

 NOTE: HTML comments are not allowed/supported.
